payload.content: Use Wikipedia table semantics when interpreting column names. Sports: score strings are complete results unless margin/difference is asked; duplicate Score columns attach to adjacent teams; Rank/Place/Position/Seed/Pick are ordinal fields, while Points, Score totals, Attendance, and Medals are magnitude fields. Elections: Candidate, Incumbent, Party, District/Riding, Result, Votes, and % are distinct roles; votes are counts and % is share. Media: Episode title, episode number, season number, series number, production code, air date, director, writer, viewers, rating, and share are distinct. Music: song, single, album, artist, producer, featured guest, sales, and chart position are distinct; chart positions are chart-specific ranks. Geography: country, county, city, state/province, location, venue, nationality, and represent are not interchangeable. Identifier tables: route codes, episode numbers, Unicode glyphs, production codes, and ranks are identifiers, not names.

Before answering, choose the table role requested by the question, then select the matching column/value. If the question asks for a named entity, do not return its identifier, rank, code, glyph, or neighboring metric unless the question explicitly asks for that field.

rationale: WTQ source-triggered domain semantics pack distilled from cube failures and GEPA-style missing-domain-knowledge blocks. This is a blocked feature, not a fine-grained add-one primitive.
